# Overrides applied when compiling semgrep.txt (see the command in its header).
#
# mcp: semgrep pins mcp==1.29.0 (still true of semgrep 1.182.1 on PyPI), which is
# affected by GHSA "MCP Python SDK: Unbounded Session Accumulation in
# StreamableHTTP Transport" (vulnerable >= 1.8.0, < 1.30.0; Dependabot alert #35).
# 1.30.0 is the patched release. CI installs semgrep.txt with
# `pip install --no-deps --require-hashes`, so the override is what gets
# installed; `semgrep scan` with this set was verified locally on semgrep 1.180.0.
# The <1.31 cap keeps this to the security fix. Drop the override once semgrep's
# own pin reaches 1.30.0.
mcp>=1.30.0,<1.31
